metrics.label: Traffic stops
metrics.description: All THP traffic stops recorded in the county in March 2018, including commercial vehicle inspections.

metrics.label: Stops excl. commercial inspections
metrics.description: Traffic enforcement stops: every stop except commercial vehicle inspections (CVE3 reports).

metrics.label: Commercial vehicle inspections
metrics.description: Stops that included a commercial vehicle inspection report (CVE3), mostly of truck tractors.
metrics.caution: Inspections concentrate near ports of entry and inspection sites.

metrics.label: Change vs. February
metrics.description: March stops per day compared with February 2018 stops per day.
metrics.caution: Counties with less than 50 stops ommitted

metrics.label: Change vs. Sep-Feb average
metrics.description: March stops per day compared with the September 2017 - February 2018 average.
metrics.caution: Counties with less than 50 stops ommitted

metrics.label: Per 10,000 residents
metrics.description: Traffic enforcement stops (commercial vehicle inspections excluded). Divided by the county's 2018 population.
metrics.caution: Rural counties crossed by interstates rank high.

metrics.label: Per million vehicle miles
metrics.description: Traffic enforcement stops (commercial vehicle inspections excluded). Divided by March vehicle miles traveled on state highways (TxDOT 2018 daily VMT x 31).

metrics.label: Stops vs. traffic expectation
metrics.description: Observed / expected traffic enforcement stops, where expected = statewide stops x the county's share of state highway vehicle miles. 1.0 = as expected. Empirical Bayes estimate with 95% interval.
metrics.caution: Describes where enforcement concentrates relative to traffic.

metrics.label: Stops with a citation
metrics.description: Share of traffic enforcement stops with at least one citation.
metrics.caution: Hidden for counties with fewer than 50 traffic enforcement stops.

metrics.label: Stops with a search
metrics.description: Share of traffic enforcement stops with a vehicle search (any type).
metrics.caution: Hidden for counties with fewer than 50 traffic enforcement stops.

metrics.label: Searches finding contraband
metrics.description: Share of searches in which contraband was found.
metrics.caution: Hidden for counties with fewer than 20 searches.

sources.name: Texas DPS, THP high-value data sets (violation extracts, Sep 2017 - Mar 2018)
